query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage Pipedrive CRM records: find deals and contacts, update deal participants and primary contacts, log notes and activities, schedule follow-ups, inspect deal and organization custom fields, and bulk reclassify deals across pipeline stages based on contract timing data.

query_ground_truth.intent: Record notes and log interaction activities against CRM records.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Sanity-check connectivity using PIPEDRIVE_GET_CURRENT_USER_DATA (confirm auth and instance config before reads/writes).
[Required] [Fallback]: If auth/connectivity fails, re-authorize using PIPEDRIVE_REQUEST_AUTHORIZATION or refresh using PIPEDRIVE_REFRESH_TOKENS, then retry PIPEDRIVE_GET_CURRENT_USER_DATA.
[Optional (if pipeline context is needed)] [Prerequisite]: Enumerate pipelines using PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_PIPELINES (confirm target pipeline exists before deal updates).

[Optional (if IDs are unknown or auditing data)] [Step]: Enumerate records using PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_PERSONS and PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS and PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEALS (paginate via limit/start until additional_data.pagination.more_items_in_collection is false).
[Optional (if activities must be reviewed in bulk)] [Step]: List activities using PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_ACTIVITIES_BETA (use for read/audit before updates).
[Required] [Step]: Find/deduplicate matches using PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_PERSONS (parse data.data.items[].item.id; paginate via additional_data.pagination; retry with alternate terms if empty).
[Required] [Step]: Create/update a person using PIPEDRIVE_ADD_A_PERSON or PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_A_PERSON, then confirm linkage via PIPEDRIVE_GET_PERSON (retain person_id and any org_id).

[Required] [Step]: Resolve organization using PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_ORGANIZATIONS and then PIPEDRIVE_ADD_AN_ORGANIZATION or PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_AN_ORGANIZATION, then verify via PIPEDRIVE_GET_ORGANIZATION or PIPEDRIVE_GET_DETAILS_OF_AN_ORGANIZATION (retain org_id).
[Required] [Step]: Create/update deal using PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_DEALS then PIPEDRIVE_ADD_A_DEAL or PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_A_DEAL, then verify via PIPEDRIVE_GET_DETAILS_OF_A_DEAL (retain deal_id).
[Required] [Step]: Create/update activity using PIPEDRIVE_ADD_AN_ACTIVITY or PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_AN_ACTIVITY (link person/org/deal IDs), then verify via PIPEDRIVE_GET_DETAILS_OF_AN_ACTIVITY.
known_pitfalls: [PIPEDRIVE_GET_CURRENT_USER_DATA] Malformed instance configuration can surface SSL hostname-mismatch/DNS-style errors; fix connection settings before retrying writes.
[PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_PERSONS] Results are nested under data.data.items[].item and pagination is in additional_data.pagination; mis-parsing can drop IDs or miss matches.
[PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_PERSONS] Email fields may be an array (email[].value) with no single primary email field; handle missing/empty primary values.
[PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS] Very large collections may appear truncated in some client pathways; rely on pagination and consider out-of-band processing for full payloads.
[PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_A_DEAL] Can fail with ERR_DEAL_PROBABILITY_NOT_ENABLED_ON_PIPELINE when sending probability to unsupported pipelines; omit probability and retry.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Pipedrive is a sales management tool built around pipeline visualization, lead tracking, activity reminders, and automation to keep deals progressing

PIPEDRIVE_ADD_A_PERSON.description: Add a new contact in Pipedrive with optional custom fields unique to each account found using the `personFields` endpoint. The endpoint also handles `data.marketing_status` for Campaigns product users.

name.description: The name of the person. REQUIRED by Pipedrive API.

label.description: Label for the item (e.g., work, home)

primary.description: Whether this is the primary item

items.description: Email/Phone item schema used by Pipedrive v1 for persons.

email.description: List of email objects: { value: string, label?: string, primary?: bool }

label.description: Label for the item (e.g., work, home)

primary.description: Whether this is the primary item

items.description: Email/Phone item schema used by Pipedrive v1 for persons.

phone.description: List of phone objects: { value: string, label?: string, primary?: bool }

owner_id.description: ID of the user who will be marked as the owner of this person

label_ids.description: IDs of labels to assign to the person

visible_to.description: Visibility of the person (e.g., 1=owner only, 3=entire company)

marketing_status.description: Marketing status (no_consent, unsubscribed, subscribed, archived). Field is available only when Campaigns is enabled.

PIPEDRIVE_ADD_AN_ORGANIZATION.description: Creates a new organization in Pipedrive. The 'name' parameter is required and represents the organization's name (e.g., 'Acme Corp'). Optionally specify 'owner_id' to assign an owner and 'visible_to' for visibility settings. Custom fields can also be added using field keys from organizationFields.

name.description: The name of the organization to create (required). This is typically a company or business name such as 'Acme Corp' or 'Tech Solutions Inc.'

PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_AN_ORGANIZATION.description: Updates the properties of an organization.

industry.description: The numeric ID of the industry option. This is an enum field with predefined options specific to your Pipedrive account. Use PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_ORGANIZATION_FIELDS to retrieve the 'industry' field and its available options (each option has an 'id' and 'label'). Pass the option 'id' here, not the label text.

annual_revenue.description: The numeric ID of the annual revenue option. This is an enum field with predefined options specific to your Pipedrive account. Use PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_ORGANIZATION_FIELDS to retrieve the 'annual_revenue' field and its available options (each option has an 'id' and 'label'). Pass the option 'id' here, not the label text.

PIPEDRIVE_GET_DETAILS_OF_AN_ORGANIZATION.description: Provides detailed information about an organization, including additional fields not shown when listing all organizations, and maps custom fields as long hashes to the 'key' value in organizationFields.

PIPEDRIVE_GET_ORGANIZATION.description: Tool to get details of a specific organization in Pipedrive. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive information about an organization by its ID.

id.description: The ID of the organization to retrieve

custom_fields.description: Comma-separated list of custom field keys to include (maximum 15 keys). Use this parameter for faster results and smaller responses when only specific custom fields are needed.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated list of additional fields to include in the response. Acceptable values: next_activity_id, last_activity_id, open_deals_count, related_open_deals_count, closed_deals_count, related_closed_deals_count, email_messages_count, people_count, activities_count, done_activities_count, undone_activities_count, files_count, notes_count, followers_count, won_deals_count, related_won_deals_count, lost_deals_count, related_lost_deals_count

PIPEDRIVE_ADD_A_DEAL.description: Add a new deal to Pipedrive with any custom fields, which vary by account and are identified by long hash keys. Check dealFields for existing custom fields. For details, visit the tutorial on adding a deal.

status.description: Status of the deal (open, won, lost). Defaults to open

user_id.description: ID of the user who will be marked as owner of this deal

currency.description: Currency for the deal value (3-letter ISO code)

person_id.description: ID of the person this deal is linked to

visible_to.description: Visibility of the deal (owner, entire company etc)

expected_close_date.description: Expected close date in format YYYY-MM-DD

PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_A_DEAL.description: Updates the properties of a deal. For more information, see the tutorial for updating a deal.

status.description: Status of the deal (open, won, lost). Defaults to open

user_id.description: ID of the user who will be marked as owner of this deal

currency.description: Currency for the deal value (3-letter ISO code)

person_id.description: ID of the person this deal is linked to

visible_to.description: Visibility of the deal (owner, entire company etc)

lost_reason.description: Reason for losing the deal (only with status=lost)

expected_close_date.description: Expected close date in format YYYY-MM-DD

PIPEDRIVE_ADD_AN_ACTIVITY.description: New activity added. Response includes `more_activities_scheduled_in_context` to show if more are planned with the same entity. See tutorial on adding activities [here](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/adding-an-activity).

done.description: Whether the activity is done (0 = not done, 1 = done)

type.description: The type of the activity (matches ActivityTypes.key_string)

deal_id.description: ID of the linked deal (integer or numeric string)

lead_id.description: ID of the linked lead (UUID string)

user_id.description: ID of the user who owns the activity

attendees.description: Attendees of the activity (contacts or external emails)

busy_flag.description: Whether the activity marks the assignee as busy

public_description.description: Public description synced to external calendar

PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_AN_ACTIVITY.description: Updates an activity. Includes `more_activities_scheduled_in_context` property in response's `additional_data` which indicates whether there are more undone activities scheduled with the same deal, person or organization (depending on the supplied data).

done.description: Whether the activity is done (0 = not done, 1 = done)

note.description: The note of the activity (HTML supported)

type.description: The type of the activity (e.g., call, meeting), correlates with ActivityTypes key_string

org_id.description: ID of the organization linked to the activity

deal_id.description: ID of the deal linked to the activity

user_id.description: ID of the user who will own the activity

due_date.description: The due date of the activity (YYYY-MM-DD)

due_time.description: The due time of the activity (HH:MM)

person_id.description: ID of the person linked to the activity

PIPEDRIVE_GET_CURRENT_USER_DATA.description: Returns data about an authorized user within the company with bound company data: company ID, company name, and domain. Note that the `locale` property means 'Date/number format' in the Pipedrive account settings, not the chosen language.

PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_PERSONS.description: This endpoint searches for individuals by various identifiers and is a specific use case of /v1/itemSearch with limited OAuth scope, allowing results filtering by organization ID.

term.description: The search term to look for. Minimum 2 characters (or 1 if using `exact_match`). Wildcards like '*' or '@' are NOT supported. To list all persons in an organization, use the GET_ALL_PERSONS or LIST_PERSONS_OF_AN_ORGANIZATION action instead.

start.description: Pagination start. Note that the pagination is based on main results and does not include related items when using `search_for_related_items` parameter.

fields.description: The field to perform the search from. Defaults to all searchable fields. Only the following custom field types are searchable: address, varchar, text, varchar_auto, double, monetary and phone.

exact_match.description: When enabled, only full exact matches against the given term are returned. It is not case sensitive.

include_fields.description: Supports including optional fields in the results which are not provided by default

organization_id.description: Will filter persons by the provided organization ID. The upper limit of found persons associated with the organization is 2000.

PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEALS.description: Returns all deals. For more information, see the tutorial for getting all deals.

sort.description: The field names and sorting mode separated by a comma (`field_name_1 ASC`, `field_name_2 DESC`). Only first-level field keys are supported (no nested keys).

limit.description: Items shown per page (1-500). If not provided, 100 items will be returned.

status.description: Only fetch deals with a specific status. If omitted, all not deleted deals are returned. If set to deleted, deals that have been deleted up to 30 days ago will be included.

user_id.description: If supplied, only deals matching the given user will be returned. However, `filter_id` and `owned_by_you` takes precedence over `user_id` when supplied.

stage_id.description: If supplied, only deals within the given stage will be returned

filter_id.description: The ID of the filter to use

owned_by_you.description: When supplied, only deals owned by you are returned. However, `filter_id` takes precedence over `owned_by_you` when both are supplied.

sort.description: The field names and sorting mode separated by a comma (`field_name_1 ASC`, `field_name_2 DESC`). Only first-level field keys are supported (no nested keys).

user_id.description: If supplied, only persons owned by the given user will be returned. However, `filter_id` takes precedence over `user_id` when both are supplied.

filter_id.description: The ID of the filter to use

first_char.description: If supplied, only persons whose name starts with the specified letter will be returned (case-insensitive)

sort.description: The field names and sorting mode separated by a comma (`field_name_1 ASC`, `field_name_2 DESC`). Only first-level field keys are supported (no nested keys).

user_id.description: If supplied, only organizations owned by the given user will be returned. However, `filter_id` takes precedence over `user_id` when both are supplied.

filter_id.description: The ID of the filter to use

first_char.description: If supplied, only organizations whose name starts with the specified letter will be returned (case-insensitive)

PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_PIPELINES.description: Returns data about all pipelines. This action retrieves all pipelines from the user's Pipedrive instance using their instance-specific URL (e.g., https://company.pipedrive.com/api/v2/pipelines).

PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_DEALS.description: This API endpoint searches deals by title, notes, and custom fields, filters results by person or organization ID, and is a specific use case of /v1/itemSearch with limited OAuth scope.

term.description: The search term to look for. Minimum 2 characters required (or 1 character if exact_match is set to true). Please note that the search term has to be URL encoded.

limit.description: Items shown per page. Maximum value is 100.

start.description: Pagination start. Note that the pagination is based on main results and does not include related items when using `search_for_related_items` parameter.

fields.description: A comma-separated string array. The fields to perform the search from. Defaults to all of them. Only the following custom field types are searchable: `address`, `varchar`, `text`, `varchar_auto`, `double`, `monetary` and `phone`. Read more about searching by custom fields here.

status.description: Will filter deals by the provided specific status. open = Open, won = Won, lost = Lost. The upper limit of found deals associated with the status is 2000.

person_id.description: Will filter deals by the provided person ID. The upper limit of found deals associated with the person is 2000.

exact_match.description: When enabled, only full exact matches against the given term are returned. It is not case sensitive.

include_fields.description: Supports including optional fields in the results which are not provided by default

organization_id.description: Will filter deals by the provided organization ID. The upper limit of found deals associated with the organization is 2000.
